#### `def MakeControlClass(controlClass, name)` (Línea 64)
- **Propósito:** Given a CoClass in a generated .py file, this function will return a Class
object which can be used as an OCX control.

This function is used when you do not want to handle any events from the OCX
control.  If you need events, then you should derive a class from both the
activex.Control class and the CoClass
- **Firma:** `def MakeControlClass(controlClass, name)`
- **Retorno / Efectos:** Consulta código fuente.

- **Propósito:** As for MakeControlClass(), but returns an instance of the class.
